$comment: dependency-audit suppressions. Copy to your project root as audit-allowlist.json.
Every entry needs id, package, reason, and expires. The expiry is not optional:
a permanent suppression is indistinguishable from having no check at all, and it
silently becomes policy. An expired entry FAILS the gate, which forces someone to
re-decide whether the reasoning still holds. Suppressions are meant to rot loudly.
Entries within 14 days of expiry are reported as warnings while still suppressing.

suppressions.reason: Advisory affects the SSR code path only; this package is used exclusively in a build-time script that never receives untrusted input. Re-evaluate if the package moves into runtime.
